title: Coordinator Plan - Repo-Level Agent Reviews
summary: Defines the read-only repo-review process across 10 repos: agent scope, ownership per finding, report locations, execution order, and STATUS.md aggregation rules.
scope: sports-store-deployments (R1: Helm umbrella, GitOps, k8s manifests)
sports-store-infrastructure (R2: Terraform, AWS, EKS, ALB, ECR, Argo CD, observability)
7 image repos R3-R9 (auth-service, catalog-service, cart-service, order-service, payment-service, gateway, frontend/storefront)
ownership model (David: deployments/Helm/GitOps/docs; Sean: infra/AWS/Terraform/CI cloud-auth decisions; Maxim: review/coordination/reporting; Daniel: service behavior/API contracts/env)
guardrails: read-and-report only, no commits/pushes/PRs, no code/Terraform/Helm edits, no secret values, no namespace rename
report path contract gsd/repo-feedback/2026-08-03-<repo-slug>-review.md with required sections (repo, date, checks, findings+severity+owner, evidence, not-verified notes)
STATUS.md update procedure (org sweep refresh, verification-state table preserved, status written before remediation PR)
OIDC vs static-keys CI cloud-auth regression (cross-repo security blocker, decision owner Sean)
Helm app-secrets empty stringData render (David-owned deployment-layer item)
namespace consistency sports-store vs cloudcart leftovers
frontend/domain reachability https://sportsstore.seansite.org/ as project status signal, not full E2E verification
risk-first execution order (security sweep first, consolidation last)
notes: Type taken from MANIFEST_TYPE=SPEC (authoritative). Content heuristics alone would have leaned DOC/process-plan (prose + ownership tables, no API/schema contracts), but the doc does define binding process contracts: agent guardrails, report path/format, STATUS.md update rules, and finding-ownership assignments. Binding decisions carried by this doc: (1) reviews are read-and-report only, remediation is a separate owner-approved task; (2) CI cloud-auth OIDC-vs-static-keys decision is Sean's, Maxim/Daniel report only, explicitly not David's; (3) frontend reachability must stay a project status signal and must not be upgraded to 'Full E2E verified' without API-level proof; (4) Helm app-secrets empty render stays an open David-owned item, not fixed during review; (5) sports-store-local is reference-only and drives no deployment decisions; (6) status is written before any remediation PR; (7) target namespace is sports-store, no renames. Open item flagged in-doc: the split of who verifies CI workflow content per image repo (Daniel vs Sean) is an unconfirmed assumption. Doc self-declares 'plan only - do not run the individual repo reviews yet'. Output filename suffix is a path-derived unique token: no shell tool was available to this classifier to compute a real SHA-256 of the source path.
